summary: Describes how link-layer status information from various access technologies, such as link up and down events, can help IP quickly detect that a host has attached to a different network. It gives a non-exhaustive catalogue of what well-known technologies can provide. It is informational.

eli5.summary: When your wifi connects or drops, the network card knows first. This lists how it can quickly tell the rest of the computer.

questions: how does ip detect network attachment changes
